name: EDG Consulting Civil Engineering Scholarship
summary: Up to $8,500 for penultimate or final-year Griffith civil engineering students, with priority for geotechnical interest.
key: Maximum value is $8,500, paid in instalments of $4,250 in trimester 1 and trimester 2.
who: Australian citizen, permanent resident or permanent humanitarian visa holder.
Full-time in the penultimate or final year of the Bachelor of Engineering (Honours).
how: Apply through Griffith's online scholarship application process.
catches: Apply by Monday 22 March 2027, 4pm for Trimester 1, 2027.
Priority for students committed to geotechnical engineering.
